decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block references, retains the $900 Small Block prizes, and updates the FAQ revenue allocation.
The prize allocation change does not alter the deferred Transak provider, payment methods, wallet provisioning, or mint destination.
Removing Big Block prizes and reallocating mint revenue does not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
A complete same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block content and limits the About page to the continuing $900 Small Block prizes.
The fixed $30 purchase allocation does not change the separate optional gratuity feature or its preset and custom amounts.
A same-message MODIFY already records the $8 purchase allocation to the continuing Small Block prize pool; the existing winner count, prize amount, and draw trigger remain unchanged.
A complete same-message MODIFY already narrows Chainlink VRF selection to the remaining Small Block draw.
A complete same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket issuance attribute while retaining Small Block ticket issuance.
A complete same-message MODIFY already removes the Big Block ticket lifecycle and narrows the requirement scope to Small Block tickets.
A complete same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket counter from NFT metadata.
The source does not cancel or change the existing one-ticket allocation for no-referral mints; it only removes the separate Big Block mechanism.
Removing Big Block prizes does not change the established automatic wallet-transfer payout mode for the continuing Small Block prizes.
